import re

TITLE = re.compile(r"^\s*Symbol table '(?P<table>[^']+)' contains (?P<count>\d+) entr")
HEAD = re.compile(r'^\s*Num:\s+Value\s+Size\s+Type\s+Bind\s+Vis\s+Ndx\s+Name')
ROW = re.compile(r'^\s*(?P<num>\d+):\s+(?P<value>[0-9a-fA-F]+)\s+(?P<size>\S+)\s+(?P<type>\S+)\s+(?P<bind>\S+)\s+(?P<vis>\S+)\s+(?P<ndx>\S+)(?:\s+(?P<name>.*?))?(?:\s+\((?P<ver>\d+)\))?\s*$')

def parse(lines):
    records = []
    used = []
    skip = []
    table = ''
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        m = TITLE.match(line)
        if m:
            table = m.group('table')
            used.append(i)
            continue
        if HEAD.match(line):
            used.append(i)
            continue
        m = ROW.match(line)
        if m:
            records.append({
                'Symbol table': table,
                'Num': int(m.group('num')),
                'Value': m.group('value'),
                'Size': m.group('size'),
                'Type': m.group('type'),
                'Bind': m.group('bind'),
                'Vis': m.group('vis'),
                'Ndx': m.group('ndx'),
                'Name': m.group('name') or '',
                'Version': m.group('ver') or '',
            })
            used.append(i)
    blocks = []
    if records:
        blocks.append({'name': 'symbols', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': used, 'records': records})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
